description: Make the persistence layer async and driver-agnostic on SQLite, with DPI 1 behaviour unchanged. This covers plan.md items 1-5 (C:/Antigravity/Urbani DPI/.agents/tasks/dpi2/item-01/plan.md) and design.md sections 2.4, 3, 4, 6, 7.1, 9.3 and 9.4. Work: ignore .tmp/; capture the HTTP baseline from the UNMODIFIED build; add the shared enums, PersistenceError and the DYNAMODB_* config; add the repository core (types.ts, common.ts, validation.ts) and db/cliErrors.ts; add migration 002 with its test; git-mv the six SQLite repositories into repositories/sqlite/ as async factories plus the new preferences/chat/health repositories; add the registry; convert every caller (8 services, 3 routes, MockDynamoDBAdapter, server.ts, seed.ts incl. the assertSeedTarget guard); update the test helpers and the 4 existing test files. Until FEAT-003 the registry's dynamodb branch throws a fatal PersistenceError. First feature; every later feature depends on it.
steps: Item 1.1: append `.tmp/` as the last line of C:\Antigravity\Urbani DPI\.worktrees\dpi2\.gitignore (after `.worktrees/`, line 42). Prove the rule with the probe command in plan.md item 1.1: git check-ignore names .gitignore:43, and git status lists only ' M .gitignore'. Delete the probe.

With -Seed it deletes the old DB files and seeds fresh, then starts, captures and stops the server in ONE call.

Item 1.4-1.6: on the UNMODIFIED sources run `npm run build`, then `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Antigravity\Urbani DPI\.worktrees\dpi2\.tmp\smoke\smoke.ps1" -Driver sqlite -Name baseline -Seed` (no -CheckDriverLine). Then build shared and backend, and run npm test: 73/73.

Item 3: add packages/backend/src/repositories/types.ts (the §3.2 block verbatim), common.ts (clampPage, compareBinary, compileLike verbatim from §4.5, likeContains, encodeCursor/decodeCursor throwing INVALID_CURSOR, newTimeOrderedId, buildAuthUser from today's toAuthUser lines 64-80) and validation.ts (the §7.3 zod rules; parse* helpers throwing PersistenceError INVALID_ARGUMENT; auditCursorSchema(from,to), sessionCursorSchema and messageCursorSchema; export names listed in plan.md item 3). Add packages/backend/src/db/cliErrors.ts: CliPreconditionError, no imports. Build and test: 73/73.

Item 4: add packages/backend/src/db/migrations/002_dpi2_persistence_foundation.sql (the §4.4 SQL verbatim) and packages/backend/src/db/migrations.test.ts with the cases in plan.md item 4: 001-only DB plus rows, then runMigrations returns ['002_dpi2_persistence_foundation']; role SUPER_ADMIN; results FAILURE/SUCCESS/SUCCESS; 4 tables exist; a re-run returns []; BOGUS role rejected. npm test: 73 plus the new test(s) pass.

Item 5.1-5.3: create packages/backend/src/repositories/sqlite/ and `git mv` the six repository files into it (command in plan.md item 5.1). Convert each into a factory (sqliteAlertRepository, sqliteServiceRepository, sqliteEnvironmentRepository, sqliteLogRepository, sqliteMetricRepository, sqliteUsageRepository, sqliteUserRepository, sqliteAIAnalysisRepository, sqliteAuditRepository, sqliteIntegrationRepository). Methods are closures with SQL and transactions verbatim, no internal await, getDb() per call, and ctx.now() instead of new Date().toISOString(). Add countAll, services.upsert, environments.ensure/all, logs/metrics/usage.upsertMany, integrations.upsert/delete, the §4.3 upsertUser SQL with parseUserRole, audit.record with result, and audit.listByTimeRange. Add sqlite/preferencesRepository.ts, sqlite/chatRepository.ts, sqlite/healthRepository.ts and sqlite/index.ts (SqliteContext, createSqliteRepositories, close -> closeDb) per §4.5.

Item 5.4: add packages/backend/src/repositories/index.ts (the §3.3 registry: getRepositories, setRepositoriesForTesting, resetRepositories, assertDynamoReachable, export * from './types'). The dynamodb branch of build() throws new PersistenceError('UNAVAILABLE', 'DB_DRIVER=dynamodb: the DynamoDB driver is not part of this build yet', { fatal: true }) until FEAT-003.

Item 5.5: convert every caller using the exact line list in plan.md item 5.5: services/alertService.ts, telemetryService.ts, aiService.ts, chatService.ts (line 80 passes 'FAILURE'), dashboardService.ts (line 30 becomes countAll), usageService.ts, settingsService.ts, authService.ts; routes/apiRoutes.ts (res.json(await ...) at 32/36/93/100/104/111/116/158/159/180/184, audit at 170), authRoutes.ts (36, 45), healthRoutes.ts (/ready async, health.ping); integrations/mock/MockDynamoDBAdapter.ts; server.ts (async main, assertDynamoReachable, dbDriver in the listening log, main().catch -> 'Startup failed' exit 1). Use `const repos = getRepositories()` inside functions and await every call.

Item 5.6: rewrite packages/backend/src/db/seed.ts per §9.3 and plan.md item 5.6: repository calls only, the driver-aware store prep, exported assertSeedTarget, and a CLI block where the guard runs first (exit 2 on CliPreconditionError), then seed(), then getRepositories().close(); other errors exit 1. Remove the getDb/closeDb imports. Keep `export { seed }`.

Item 5.7: test/setup.ts adds process.env.DB_DRIVER = 'sqlite'. test/testDb.ts freshTestDb() calls resetRepositories(). Update repositories/alertCorrelation.test.ts, services/alertService.test.ts and services/authService.test.ts for async plus registry. In alertService.test.ts, authService.test.ts and chatService.test.ts, delete `import type Database from 'better-sqlite3'` and declare `let db: ReturnType<typeof freshTestDb>;` (the FR5.4 type-only edit). No assertion is removed or weakened.

Run the verification below and commit on dpi2, staging by path, e.g. `refactor(backend): async driver-agnostic repository layer on SQLite (DPI2 item 1)`. Item 1's .gitignore and fixture may be a separate earlier commit (`chore(dpi2): ignore .tmp/ and capture route baseline`).

NOTES FOR LATER STEPS.
- Throwaway tooling: <wt>\.tmp\smoke\capture.mjs and smoke.ps1. smoke.ps1 exit codes: capture's 0/1; 2 usage (also -Seed with dynamodb, or a missing -Baseline file); 3 driver-line check failed; 4 port 4100 already listening; 5 seed failed; 6 server not listening within 30 s; 7 port 4100 still listening after stop. smoke.ps1 sets ENV-SQLITE(<Name>) or ENV-DYNAMO(<Prefix>) plus PORT=4100 itself.
- Key-set algorithm as implemented in capture.mjs (FEAT-002 keySet.ts must be an identical copy): an object adds 'parent.key' (or 'key' at the top) and recurses; an array recurses into each element under 'parent[]'; an element that is a primitive other than null (typeof !== 'object') adds 'parent[]'; a null element or a null/primitive value adds nothing; result sorted, distinct. capture.mjs sends no Authorization header for steps 01-03 and 'Bearer <token>' from step 04.
- routes.baseline.json is committed; never regenerate it from modified code.
- repositories/index.ts: the dynamodb branch of build() throws PersistenceError('UNAVAILABLE', 'DB_DRIVER=dynamodb: the DynamoDB driver is not part of this build yet', { fatal: true }); FEAT-003 replaces exactly that branch with the design §3.3 branch. assertDynamoReachable logs warn with { awsError: err.awsErrorName ?? err.reason } (or err.name for non-PersistenceErrors) and rethrows only fatal PersistenceErrors.
- common.ts exports clampPage, compareBinary, compileLike (verbatim §4.5), likeContains, encodeCursor(parts), decodeCursor(cursor, schema) (generic over a zod schema; max 1,024 chars; base64url alphabet check; {v:1,k}), newTimeOrderedId(nowIso) (per-process strictly increasing ms), buildAuthUser(user, role).
- validation.ts exports parseUserRole(role?) (undefined or null -> null), parseAuditResult(result?) (default SUCCESS), parseAuditRangeQuery(opts) -> { from, to, actor, limit, cursor } where from/to are normalised ISO or null, limit is z.number().int() clamped to 1..200 (default 50), actor 1-320 chars, and cursor is still encoded (decode with decodeCursor(cursor, auditCursorSchema(from, to))); parsePreferencesPatch(userId, patch) -> { userId, theme?, widgetLayout? } (key absent = keep, null = clear); parseNewChatSession, parseNewChatMessage, parseChatFeedbackInput (normalise optional fields to null, citations to []); parseReadId(id) (1-128 chars); clampSessionLimit (1..100, default 20) and clampMessageLimit (1..500, default 200), never rejecting; auditCursorSchema(from?, to?), sessionCursorSchema, messageCursorSchema. Only cursor === undefined means 'no cursor'; an empty-string cursor raises INVALID_CURSOR.
- sqlite/index.ts exports SqliteContext { now } and createSqliteRepositories(opts?: RepositoryOptions). Every SQLite repository is a factory of local functions (no this, no internal await), calls getDb() per method and uses ctx.now() for generated timestamps. integrations.delete is the local function deleteById exported under the 'delete' key. The new SQLite repositories raise PersistenceError INVALID_ARGUMENT (validation), REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND (user/session/message checks) and DUPLICATE (session id) with generic messages; legacy paths keep raw SqliteError.
- seed.ts: DynamoDB store prep throws 'DynamoDB store is not ready (<reason>); run npm run dynamo:tables first'. CLI: assertSeedTarget(config.db, argv) first; CliPreconditionError -> logger.error(message), exit 2; any other error -> 'Seed failed' { message }, exit 1. In FEAT-001, DB_DRIVER=dynamodb with an endpoint exits 1 because the registry throws.
